instruction: On my Ubuntu system, please guide me in making Evince the default application for opening PDF files.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Evince as the default PDF viewer in Ubuntu. Similar to the original VLC video player task, this uses xdg-mime to query the default application for the application/pdf MIME type. The evaluator checks if the default PDF viewer contains 'evince.desktop'.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'xdg-mime query default application/pdf' to extract the default PDF viewer on Ubuntu
Metric check_include_exclude appropriately verifies that the result contains 'evince.desktop'
Expected value 'evince.desktop' is semantically correct for Evince PDF viewer
Complete coverage: instruction asks to set Evince as default PDF viewer, evaluator checks exactly that
Data flow is correct: getter extracts default PDF viewer string → metric checks if 'evince.desktop' is in result
Substring matching in check_include_exclude is beneficial for handling different desktop file naming conventions (evince.desktop, org.gnome.Evince.desktop, etc.)
Will work correctly at runtime with standard xdg-mime output
